title: Large Bomb
body:
"Can be used to output a huge explosion, with a small radius. Any bombs which blow up other explosives will have a chain reaction, and explosives can be used to chop trees or break ores."

The Large Bomb is an explosive that can be purchased from the Pirate Boat or Dugg's Digging for $1200 . It is a large version of the standard Small Bomb.

Description

The Large Bomb has an extremely powerful explosion, but a moderate radius. The Large Bomb's blast can instantly open any destructible wall in the game.

Unlike dynamite, bombs have a delayed chain reaction.

Trivia

  • This item used to cost $16000. Its price was reduced to $5000 in an earlier update. In Version 1.50.0, the price was reduced to $1200.
  • This item is the cheapest way to destroy any destructible wall, the second place being the Dynamite Stick x7, but these can roll and dont destroy the wall, making you waste a bomb
